title: Analytics
off_hint: Turning this off immediately stops new sending and clears the unsent queue. Already-sent data stays in the cloud until deleted.
summary: Optional usage data helps us improve VStudy Pro: feature activity, estimated active time, AI usage counts, and coarse reliability and device information.
excluded: We never collect your name, email, student ID, credentials, questions, answers, document contents, titles, paths, or search text.
pseudonymous: A random installation ID links your activity over time. This is pseudonymous data, not legally anonymous data. PostHog receives your connection IP, but the app disables IP-based location enrichment. Studying works with analytics off. You can change your choice in Privacy settings.
invitation: Help improve VStudy Pro? Analytics is off until you choose.
collect_device: Device and OS: OS family and major/minor version, architecture, app language/version, memory and CPU core-count buckets, display size/scale buckets, Electron/Chrome major versions.
collect_activity: Random installation, session, event and request IDs; timestamps; screens and settings; foreground-active, idle and background time estimates; coarse failures and startup timing.
collect_ai: AI provider/model/effort, reported token counts and latency; question character counts and broad feature/source categories. No question or answer text.
collect_school: Optional discovery source and verified school from Moodle, with connection status. No Moodle URL or student identity.
pending: Deletion requested locally. Cloud deletion is not complete.
delete: Request deletion of my cloud data
delete_hint: This turns analytics off and clears unsent data. You must contact the publisher privately with this ID to request deletion of the cloud person and associated events. Do not post your ID publicly.
contact_instructions: Follow the returned publisher instructions below. The repository is only a way to find the publisher, not a public deletion form.
email_hint: Entering an email does not subscribe you. Product updates have separate consent and can be unsubscribed from independently.
newsletter_failed: We could not subscribe you. Try again, or continue without subscribing.
acquisition: How did you hear about VStudy Pro?
intro: Help improve VStudy Pro with usage data. We never collect your name, documents, questions or answers. Studying works the same either way.
saved_hint: You already made this choice. Changing it takes effect right away and never affects studying.
